header.title: How to Install a Garbage Disposer
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to install a garbage disposer, covering everything from removing the old strainer to connecting the wiring.

steps.description: Remove the strainer body from the sink by unscrewing a nut and pushing it upwards.
actions: Remove the strainer body from the sink
Unscrew the large nut that holds it in place underneath the sink
Push the strainer body up through the sink hole
Clean off the old plumber’s putty that surrounds the edge of the drain opening

steps.description: This step involves installing the new sink flange and mounting assembly components into the sink drain opening.
actions: Separate the parts of the mounting assembly from the disposer
Loosen the screws of the mounting assembly
Remove the snap ring
Place a 1/4-inch bead of plumber’s putty around the drain opening in the sink
Drop the new sink flange into the drain opening
Press the sink flange into place
Slide the fiber gasket and backup ring onto the sleeve
Hold the fiber gasket and backup ring in place
Slip on the mounting ring
Slip on the snap ring
steps.part: mounting assembly, sink flange, drain opening, sleeve, fiber gasket, backup ring, mounting ring, snap ring

steps.description: Tighten the mounting screws in an alternating pattern until the mounting assembly is securely seated against the sink bottom.
actions: Tighten the three mounting screws.
Alternate tightening each screw a few turns at a time.
Ensure the mounting assembly is evenly seated.
Ensure the mounting assembly is tightly seated against the bottom of the sink.

steps.description: Remove the dishwasher knockout plug from inside the disposer by tapping it out with a screwdriver and hammer.
actions: Lay the disposal unit on its side
Tap out the dishwasher knockout plug

steps.description: This step details how to connect the electrical wiring to the disposer unit, emphasizing safety precautions and proper grounding.
actions: Lay the disposer on its side under the sink.
Check local building codes regarding electrical connections.
Turn off electrical power at the fuse box or circuit breaker.
Remove the electrical cover plate.
Ensure the disposer is grounded.
Remove the plate on the bottom of the disposer to expose the wiring.
Connect the white wire from the disposer unit with the white wire from the power supply using wire nuts.
Connect the black wire from the disposer unit with the black wire from the power supply using wire nuts.
Connect the ground wire from the supply to the ground on the disposer unit.
Replace the plate to cover the wires.
